response: Yes, surrogates of injury severity can influence the occurrence of heterotopic ossification (HO) in fractures of the acetabulum. Specifically, factors such as days spent in the ICU and non-ICU hospital stay longer than 10 days have been associated with the development of HO in patients with acetabular fractures. Additionally, prophylaxis with radiation therapy (XRT) has been shown to be significantly protective against the development of HO, and the ability to provide this prophylaxis is likely related to the severity of the injury. Therefore, it is essential to consider the severity of the injury when assessing the risk of HO in patients with acetabular fractures.
